summary: Tested task due-soon reminders + regression after startup/CORS/auth changes. Backend 16/16 pytest passed. Frontend NotificationBell smoke passed - shows unread badge (7) and 'Task due soon' notifications referencing TEST_ReminderTask linking to /dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: scan_due_reminders() correctly filters status!=done, non-empty assignee, due_date<=horizon, and !reminded. Idempotent via 'reminded' flag - verified.
update_task resets 'reminded' only when due_date or assignee_id are in the update payload - verified via test.
Reminder loop runs every 1800s via asyncio.create_task in startup; wrapped with try/except - fine.
CORS reads CORS_ORIGINS env with FRONTEND_URL fallback (allow_credentials=True) - preserved.
AUTH_SESSION_URL is now env-configurable in routers/auth.py with sensible default.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ReminderProject + TEST_ReminderTask (assignee=alice, due=today). Auto-cleaned in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reminders feature + startup/CORS/auth changes verified end-to-end. New pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_reminders_regression.py covers 4 seed logins, /auth/me, protected routes with/without token, google authorize URL, admin disable/reinstate flow, scan-reminders (admin-only 200 + non-admin 403), notification created with type=task_due title='Task due soon' body referencing task link='/dashboard', no duplicate on 2nd scan, reminded flag resets on PUT /api/tasks/{id} due_date/assignee change. NotificationBell UI renders and displays task_due notifications with unread badge count.
